name: Option 16
definition: List of elements which provide the parameters of an option trade.

Data.name: Data
Data.definition: Type of data to indicate whether a trade is an option or resulted by an option exercise.

ExerciseStatus.name: Exercise Status
ExerciseStatus.definition: Specifies the exercise status of the option.

ExerciseStyle.name: Exercise Style
ExerciseStyle.definition: Defines how an option can be exercised.

OptionType.name: Option Type
OptionType.definition: Choice of format for option type.

OptionPayoutType.name: Option Payout Type
OptionPayoutType.definition: Indicates the type of payout that will result from an in-the-money option.

ValuationRate.name: Valuation Rate
ValuationRate.definition: Specifies the valuation rate used for the trade.

StrikePrice.name: Strike Price
StrikePrice.definition: Specifies the rate of exchange at which the foreign exchange option has been struck.

VolatilityMargin.name: Volatility Margin
VolatilityMargin.definition: Annualized volatility for option model calculations.

RiskAmount.name: Risk Amount
RiskAmount.definition: Measurement of the amount of the trade values converted in the US dollars.

ExpiryDateAndTime.name: Expiry Date And Time
ExpiryDateAndTime.definition: Date on which a privilege (for example, option, right, warrant.) expires. If it is an European option, the option holder can only exercise the right or let it lapse on expiry date. If it is an American option, the option holder can exercise the right up to the expiry date.

SettlementType.name: Settlement Type
SettlementType.definition: Specifies the settlment period of the option trade.

OptionAmounts.name: Option Amounts
OptionAmounts.definition: Specifies the call and the put amount of the underlying foreign exchange trade.

Premium.name: Premium
Premium.definition: Specifies the amount of the premium of a foreign exchange option trade and its settlement place.

SettlementAmountType.name: Settlement Amount Type
SettlementAmountType.definition: Indicates whether the trade is to be settled as principal or netted off against another trade.

AdditionalOptionInformation.name: Additional Option Information
AdditionalOptionInformation.definition: Free format text that may contain information on the option.

EarliestExerciseDateRule.definition: If ExerciseStyle is AMER, then EarliestExerciseDate must be present.
